title: Allergic potential & molecular mechanism of skin sensitization of cinnamaldehyde under environmental UVB exposure.
authors: Patel, Sunil Kumar; Vikram, Apeksha; Pathania, Diksha; Chugh, Rashi; Gaur, Prakriti; Prajapati, Gaurav; Kotian, Sumana Y; Satyanarayana, G N V; Yadav, Akhilesh Kumar; Upadhyay, Atul Kumar; Ray, Ratan Singh; Dwivedi, Ashish
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肉桂醛在UVB暴露下的皮肤致敏分子机制，涉及小分子与蛋白的对接模拟，但核心是皮肤过敏毒理学，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法用于核酸-蛋白互作建模。
abstract: Fragrance, a key ingredient in cosmetics, often triggers skin allergy causes rashes, itching, dryness, and cracked or scaly skin. Cinnamaldehyde (CA), derived from the bark of the cinnamon tree, used as a fragrance and is a moderate skin sensitizer. CA exhibits strong UVB absorption, its allergic potential and the molecular mechanisms underlying skin sensitization under UVB exposure remain largely unexplored. To investigate the allergic potential and molecular mechanisms of CA-induced skin sensitization under ambient UVB radiation, we employed various alternative in-silico, in-chemico and in-vitro tools. CA under ambient UVB isomerizes from trans to cis CA after 1hr of exposure. Furthermore, DPRA assay and docking with simulation studies demonstrated the enhanced allergic potential of cis-CA. Additionally, our study evaluated intracellular ROS levels and the expression of Nrf2, Catalase, and MMP-2, and 9 in KeratinoSens cells, showing significant upregulation under UVB exposure in the presence of CA. Moreover, our findings indicate that CA activates THP-1 cells co-stimulatory surface marker (CD86) via the activation of intracellular ROS, phagocytosis, and genes of the TLR4 pathway. These insights into the mechanisms uncovered by our study are crucial for managing triggers of allergic skin diseases caused by fragrance use and concurrent exposure to environmental UVB/sunlight.
abstract_zh: 香料是化妆品中的关键成分，常引发皮肤过敏，导致皮疹、瘙痒、干燥以及皮肤开裂或脱屑。肉桂醛（CA），源自肉桂树皮，用作香料，是一种中等程度的皮肤致敏剂。CA表现出强烈的UVB吸收能力，但其在UVB暴露下的致敏潜力及皮肤致敏的分子机制尚未得到充分探索。为研究环境UVB辐射下CA诱导皮肤致敏的过敏潜力及分子机制，我们采用了多种替代性计算机模拟、化学体外和细胞体外工具。CA在环境UVB下暴露1小时后，从反式异构化为顺式CA。此外，DPRA实验及对接与模拟研究表明，顺式CA的致敏潜力增强。进一步地，我们的研究评估了KeratinoSens细胞中细胞内ROS水平及Nrf2、过氧化氢酶、MMP-2和MMP-9的表达，结果显示在CA存在下UVB暴露时这些指标显著上调。此外，我们的发现表明，CA通过激活细胞内ROS、吞噬作用及TLR4通路基因，激活THP-1细胞共刺激表面标志物（CD86）。我们研究揭示的这些机制对于管理因使用香料及同时暴露于环境UVB/阳光而引发的过敏性皮肤病诱因至关重要。
